name: Nabisco Aurora Sales & Distribution Center - Aurora CO

fieldNotes.locate: Roster gave APPROXIMATE ZIP-level (80011) coordinates. Resolved via web research (Superpages, Chamber of Commerce, Yellowpages, Bandana) to 17689 E 30th Ave, Aurora CO 80011, then geocoded via Google Geocoding API to a ROOFTOP point at 39.7588784, -104.7818061. Locked to the tan-roof warehouse there.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck court and dock face are on the EAST side of the building. Driveways into the court are open paved curb cuts; no barrier arm or guard booth identified in satellite or Street View. Street View shows a black metal perimeter fence along the SOUTH frontage (car-parking side), so a sliding gate at the truck court entrance is possible but not resolvable - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No gate-side booth identified at either truck-court driveway. Flagged uncertain (entrance partly tree-obscured in Street View).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate confirmed, so no remote check-in inferred; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: East face is the dock face; ~8-12 trailers/rigs backed in with empty positions between, implying roughly 15-25 doors. Band 10-25, count ~20 - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: East truck court holds a mix of tractor-trailer rigs being loaded (DSD/sales operation) and some dropped trailers; band 10-25 - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: The east truck court functions as both dock staging and trailer parking and is reasonably full of trailers; dropYard set true.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two open driveways serve the east truck court (one toward the NE, one toward the SE), allowing distinct in/out points.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long open east truck court gives deep stacking room for 3+ trucks before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors observed only on the east face; no second distinct dock bank - shipRcvSeparate false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility is in a dense Aurora/Denver-metro industrial park (Stapleton/Northfield area), surrounded by large warehouses - Urban.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Open east truck court inside the property functions as a holding/queue area before the docks.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two driveway entrances to the east truck court observed.
